homesickness noun and phrase

also homesick, I’m homesick, nostalgia, be homesick

classical

M-O s.v. nostalgia

patriae dēsīderium

Other words

  • mē dēsīderium tenet — I’m homesick for

    classical · Traupman 154; Traupman 329

    + gen.

  • ex dēsīderiō labōrāre — to be homesick, pine for someone or something

    also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 6.11 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 154

  • ex dēsīderiō labōrāre
